output_dir.description: Directory where extracted thumbnails and metadata will be written. Corresponds to the -o option.

html_report.description: Whether to generate an HTML report to preview thumbnails. Corresponds to the -H option.

utf8_encoding.description: Whether to use UTF-8 encodings for metadata extraction. Corresponds to the -U option.

create_symlinks.description: Whether to create symlinks of the picture realname to the numbered name. Corresponds to the -s option.

input_files.description: List of Thumbs.db file paths to process. Corresponds to the positional file argument in the command line.
